segments.content: WLOG sort a₁ < a₂ < ... < aₙ (by applying a permutation)——不失一般性地将跳跃长度排序，把问题归约到有序情形
Let x = a₁ + ... + a_{n-1} (sum of all but the largest element)——定义关键变量x为除最大元素外所有元素之和
We proceed by strong induction on n——对n施加强归纳
Three cases based on the position of M's elements relative to x——以x为分界点对M中元素位置做情况划分
Case 1 (x ∈ M and ∃ y ∈ M with y > x): Then n ≥ 3——给出Case 1的条件并推断n≥3
Among the n-1 small elements, define 'bad' index i if x - aᵢ ∈ M or s - aᵢ ∈ M——在n-1个小元素中定义'坏指标'，为鸽巢论证做准备
The map from bad indices to M\{x} is injective (x - aᵢ maps to M\{x} since x ∈ M and aᵢ > 0; s - aᵢ > x so maps to M∩(x,∞))——证明坏指标到M\{x}的映射是单射
Since |M\{x}| = n-2, there are at most n-2 bad indices among n-1 total, so at least one good index r exists with x - aᵣ ∉ M and s - aᵣ ∉ M——由鸽巢论证得出好指标r的存在性
Let t = x - aᵣ, M' = M ∩ (-∞, t]. Then |M'| ≤ n-3 (since both x and y are excluded from M')——构造子问题的禁集M'并估计其大小
Apply induction to the n-2 remaining elements (excluding aᵣ and aₙ) with M', getting permutation p'——对n-2个剩余元素(排除aᵣ和aₙ)应用归纳假设
Construct the full permutation: place p' first, then aᵣ, then aₙ (with a swap to put aₙ second-to-last)——构造完整排列：p'前置、aᵣ居中、aₙ最后(含swap)
All prefix sums before aᵣ are ≤ t and avoid M'; the sum up to aᵣ is s - aₙ = s - aᵣ - (sum of rest) which avoids M by choice of r; the final sum is s ∉ M——验证Case 1构造的所有前缀和都避开M
Case 2 (x ∉ M and ∃ y ∈ M with y > x): Then |M ∩ (-∞, x]| ≤ n-2——给出Case 2的条件并估计M在x以下部分的规模
Let M' = M ∩ (-∞, x]. Apply induction to a₁,...,a_{n-1} with M' (sum = x ∉ M')——构造子问题禁集M'并对前n-1个元素应用归纳
If M' is empty, use identity. Otherwise get permutation p', extend by placing aₙ last——处理M'为空的边界情形，否则取p'并把aₙ放最后
All prefix sums of first n-1 jumps are ≤ x and avoid M'; the final sum is s ∉ M——验证Case 2构造的所有前缀和都避开M
Case 3 (all m ∈ M satisfy m ≤ x): Let z = max(M), M' = M\{z}——给出Case 3的条件，取z=max(M)并构造M'
Apply induction to a₁,...,a_{n-1} with M' (|M'| = n-2). Get permutation p'——对前n-1个元素应用归纳假设得到p'

If some prefix sum of p' equals z at position k, swap position k with the last position: place aₙ at position k (jumping over z since aₙ > a_{p'(k)}), and place a_{p'(k)} last——若p'某前缀和命中z，用swap技巧让aₙ跳过z
If no prefix sum equals z, p' already avoids all of M (since M = M' ∪ {z} and z is never hit)——若无前缀和命中z，则p'已避开整个M
The general case (unsorted a) is reduced to the sorted case by composing with the sorting permutation——一般(未排序)情形通过复合排序置换归约到已排序情形，兑现WLOG
